purpose: Native Microsoft Office fixture coverage inventory for the Office format completeness goal.

policy.native_producer: Fixtures are intended to be authored and saved by local Microsoft Word, Excel or PowerPoint, then closed and reopened in the same application.
policy.no_library_changes: This inventory covers test-data only; it does not authorize or require library/test code changes.
policy.status_rule: Every supported or partial feature remains pending unless a current native fixture directly evidences that exact scope. Native fixture evidence is partial and fixture-specific; it never promotes an entire format or broad cluster. Unsupported and not-applicable matrix rows remain explicit library boundaries.
policy.unsupported_behavior: Macros, ActiveX, OLE, DDE, external links, connections, add-ins, field refresh, formula recalculation, rendering and media playback remain inert or unsupported where the authoritative matrix says so.

residual_matrix_pending_categories.semantics: These categories explain why a matrix row remains pending; direct native package evidence is explicit as native-bounded when typed projections, combined scopes or operations remain unverified. New metadata/layout rows stay pending where the audit gives only a bounded sub-scope or a negative control.

operation_unverified.basis: The latest final coverage review classifies these rows as library transaction/projection/validation/runtime/transport or generic operation semantics that a saved Office file cannot close.

native_ui_unavailable.basis: The latest final coverage review records a session/version/locale-scoped native UI or deterministic producer limitation; this is not a universal unsupported claim.

externally_blocked.basis: The latest final coverage review records password, certificate/identity/trust, provider/account/service, add-in or external-runtime prerequisites; format support is not inferred.

native_bounded_evidence_operation_unveri.basis: The latest final coverage review records exact native package/UI evidence for a bounded sub-scope, while typed projection, CRUD, recalculation, rendering, runtime, child-following, editing or semantic parity remains unverified; feature_status stays pending.

genuinely_missing_authorable_family.basis: No current feature row remains in this bucket; rtf-490 was closed by the finalized native tracked-moves probe. Future authorable gaps must be classified by a new authoritative audit.

excluded_baseline.basis: No current feature row remains in an explicit excluded-baseline bucket; pending password candidates remain excluded from fixture files and are represented by external-handoff rows.

unknown.basis: The latest final coverage review classified every current pending row; no unknown rows remain.

existing_library_boundary.basis: These rows already carry fixture_status=library_boundary from the authoritative feature matrices; native fixture work does not override that status.
